1-0.answer: There is a park near my house.
Is there a library in your town?

1-0.q: There ___ lots of shops in my street.
Is there a zoo in your town?

options: There isn't a cinema in my town.
There aren't a cinema in my town.
There not a cinema in my town.

1-1.answer: The bank is next to the park.
The school is on Green Street.

1-1.q: The café is ___ the bank and the shop.

options: The shop is opposite to the school.
The shop is opposite the school.
The shop opposite is the school.

1-2.answer: Excuse me, how do I get to the park?

1-2.q: Excuse me, how do I get to the zoo?

1-3.answer: Can I have a ruler, please?

1-4.answer: I go to school by bus.
How do you get to the mall?

1-4.q: My dad goes to work ___ metro.
Why do you walk to the park?

options: I go to school by walk.
I walk at school by foot.

1-5.answer: In my street there is a big park.

1-5.q: I want a pool ___ I like swimming.

options: In my street there is two cafés.
In my street there are two cafés.
In my street it are two cafés.

0-0.answer: I get up at seven o'clock.
What time do you have breakfast?

0-0.q: "What time do you go to school?" Choose the best reply.

options: I gets up at six o'clock.

0-1.answer: Do you have Art on Monday?

0-1.q: My favourite subject is English because it's ___.
"Do you have Music on Thursday?" Choose the best reply.

options: Do you has Science on Wednesday?
My favourite subject is PE because it's exciting.

0-2.answer: I always eat fruit for breakfast.
How often do you drink water?

0-2.q: "How often do you eat sweets?" Choose the best reply.

0-3.answer: After school I do my homework.
First I play football, then I watch TV.

0-3.q: "Can you play in the park after school?" Choose the best reply.

options: Can you plays tennis after school?

0-4.answer: Can I help you with the cooking?

0-4.q: I help my dad ___ the car.
"Who cooks dinner in your house?" Choose the best reply.

options: Who make the beds in your house?
I help my mum with the shopping.

0-5.answer: In the evening I read a book.
At the weekend I visit my grandma.

0-5.q: I think my day is busy ___ I have lots of lessons.
Teacher: "What do you do in the afternoon?" Choose the best reply.

options: At the weekend I sleep late.
In the morning I goes to school.
I think my day are fun.

2-0.answer: The boy is flying a kite.
In my picture, he is running, not walking.

2-0.q: Two girls ___ playing on the swings.

2-1.answer: My dad is cooking in the kitchen.
What are you doing right now?

2-1.q: What are you doing right now?

options: My sister is playing a game.

2-2.answer: It's hot and sunny in Riyadh.
People are swimming because it's hot.

2-2.q: What's the weather like in Abha?
It's windy, so the children are ___ kites.

2-3.answer: She's wearing a red dress and shoes.
It's cold, so I need a coat.

2-4.answer: She's kicking the ball to Sara.

2-5.answer: He usually walks, but today he's running.
Why are you wearing a coat today?

2-5.q: I usually ___ to school, but today I'm going by car.
Why are you staying at home today?

options: She usually reading, but today she draws.
She is usually read, but today she drawing.
She usually reads, but today she's drawing.

3-0.answer: I was at the park on Saturday.

options: I was at my grandma's house.

3-0.q: We ___ at the beach last weekend.

3-1.answer: Did you watch TV on Sunday?

3-1.q: Did you play football on Saturday?
First I had breakfast, ___ I went to the park.

options: On Sunday I watched a film.
On Sunday I watching a film.
On Sunday I watch a film last week.

3-2.answer: I got a present from my uncle.

3-2.q: What did you do at Eid?

options: I wear a new dress last Eid.
I wore a new dress at Eid.
I weared a new dress at Eid.

3-3.answer: We went to the desert by car.

options: We seed camels in the desert.
We saw camels in the desert.

3-4.q: We need some ___ for the party.

options: What do you want to eat?

3-5.answer: My best day was my birthday.
I liked it because it was fun.

3-5.q: We went to the zoo and ___ we ate ice cream.

options: It were the best day because I saw my cousins.
It was the best day because I saw my cousins.
It was the best day because I see my cousins.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock.
I wash my face with cold water.
I brush my teeth after breakfast.
Then I get dressed for school.
I have breakfast with my family.
I go to school by bus.

dialogue.t: What time do you get up?
I get up at six o'clock. What about you?
I get up at seven o'clock. Then I wash my face.
Do you brush your teeth before breakfast?
No, I brush my teeth after breakfast.
Me too! Then I get dressed and go to school by car.
I go to school by bus. My bus comes at half past seven.

grammar.title: Present simple for daily routines
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للحديث عن الأشياء التي نفعلها كل يوم، مثل: I get up. نستخدم at مع الساعة: at seven o'clock. ونستخدم before بمعنى «قبل» و after بمعنى «بعد». وللسؤال عن الوقت نقول: What time do you ...?
examples: I get up at seven o'clock.
I have breakfast before school.
What time do you go to school?

words.ex: Look at my school timetable.
My favourite subject is Art.
On Sunday I have Maths.
Science is interesting because we do experiments.
We play football in PE.
I love Art because I can draw pictures.

dialogue.t: Hi! What lessons do you have on Sunday?
On Sunday I have Maths, English and Science.
Do you have PE on Monday?
Yes, I do. We play football. Do you have Art on Monday?
No, I don't. I have Art on Tuesday.
What's your favourite subject?
My favourite subject is Science because it's interesting.
My favourite subject is PE because it's fun!

grammar.title: Do you have ...? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
grammar.ar: للسؤال بنعم أو لا في المضارع البسيط نضع Do في بداية الجملة: Do you have Maths? نجيب باختصار: Yes, I do أو No, I don't، ولا نكرر الفعل have في الإجابة. نستخدم on مع أيام الأسبوع: on Sunday.
examples: Do you have English on Sunday?
Yes, I do.
No, I don't. I have English on Monday.

words.ex: I always drink milk in the morning.
I usually walk to school.
I sometimes eat sweets.
I never drink cola.
She eats fruit every day.
Vegetables are healthy.

dialogue.t: How often do you eat fruit?
I always eat fruit. I love apples and bananas.
How often do you drink water?
I drink water every day.
Do you eat sweets?
Sometimes. But I never drink cola.
Great! Teacher, Ali always eats fruit. He drinks water every day and he never drinks cola.

grammar.title: Adverbs of frequency and he/she + -s
grammar.ar: كلمات التكرار مثل always و usually و sometimes و never تأتي قبل الفعل: I always eat fruit. للسؤال عن عدد المرات نقول: How often do you ...? وعندما نتحدث عن he أو she نضيف s إلى الفعل: He eats, She drinks.
examples: I usually go to bed at nine o'clock.
How often do you play outside?
She drinks milk every day.

words.ex: I do my homework after lunch.
I play football with my friends.
Can you ride your bike after school?
I watch TV for one hour.
I like reading books in the evening.
We have family time after dinner.

dialogue.t: What do you do after school?
After school I have lunch. First I do my homework, then I watch TV.
I don't like watching TV for a long time. I like playing football.
Can you play football after school today?
Yes, I can! First homework, then football at five o'clock.
Good idea. And then family time?
Yes. Then I have dinner with my family and read a book.

grammar.title: like / don't like + -ing
grammar.ar: بعد like و don't like نضيف ing إلى الفعل: I like playing، I don't like watching TV. نستخدم First ثم then لترتيب الأحداث: First I do my homework, then I play. ونستخدم Can you ...? لنسأل عن قدرة شخص أو لنطلب منه شيئًا.
examples: I like riding my bike.
First I eat lunch, then I do my homework.
Can you come to the park after school?

words.ex: My sister washes the dishes after dinner.
I make my bed every morning.
My dad cooks dinner on Friday.
I clean my room at the weekend.
My brother takes out the rubbish.
Who feeds the cat in your house?

dialogue.t: Who cooks dinner in your house?
My mum cooks dinner. I help my mum with the salad.
Who washes the dishes?
My sister washes the dishes, and my brother takes out the rubbish.
In my house, my dad feeds the cat. I make my bed every day.
Look, Mum is busy. Mum, can I help you with the dishes?
That's kind! I can help too.

grammar.title: Who ...? and Can I help you with ...?
grammar.ar: نستخدم Who بمعنى «مَن» للسؤال عن الشخص الذي يقوم بالعمل، ويأخذ الفعل بعده s: Who cooks dinner? وعند الحديث عن my brother أو my sister نضيف s أيضًا: My sister washes. ولنعرض المساعدة بلطف نقول: Can I help you with ...?
examples: Who cleans the kitchen in your house?
My brother feeds the cat.
Can I help you with the shopping, Dad?

words.ex: In the morning I go to school.
In the afternoon I play with my friends.
In the evening I have dinner with my family.
At the weekend I visit my grandma.
I think my day is busy.
I go to bed at nine o'clock.

dialogue.t: Hello! This is my day. In the morning I get up at six o'clock and go to school.
In the afternoon I do my homework and play football.
In the evening I read a book and go to bed at nine o'clock.
At the weekend I visit my grandparents. I think my day is fun because I play a lot.
Thank you! What's your favourite part of the day?
My favourite part is the afternoon because I play with my friends.
Who do you visit at the weekend?
I visit my grandma and grandpa. They live near the sea.

grammar.title: Time phrases: in the morning / at the weekend
grammar.ar: نستخدم in مع أجزاء اليوم: in the morning، in the afternoon، in the evening. لكن نستخدم at مع at the weekend و at night. ولنعبّر عن رأينا ونعطي السبب نقول: I think ... because ...
examples: In the evening I watch TV with my family.
At the weekend I go to the park.
I think my day is busy because I have a lot of homework.

words.ex: There is a big park near my house.
Is there a library in your town?
There is a supermarket next to my school.
There is a beautiful mosque in my street.
There isn't a hospital near my house.
There are two swimming pools in my town.

dialogue.t: Hi! Welcome to my neighbourhood.
Thanks! Is there a park near your house?
Yes, there is a big park near my house. There are lots of trees.
Cool! Is there a library?
No, there isn't a library. But there are some shops. What's in your town?
There is a swimming pool, and there are lots of cafés.
Wow! I want to visit your town!

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.ar: نستخدم There is مع الاسم المفرد، ونستخدم There are مع الاسم الجمع، ومعناهما «يوجد / توجد». للسؤال نقدّم is فنقول: Is there a ...? وللنفي نقول: There isn't a .... كلمة some تعني «بعض»، وlots of تعني «الكثير من»، ونستخدمهما مع الجمع.
examples: There is a mosque near my house.
There are lots of shops in my town.
Is there a park in your town? No, there isn't.

words.ex: The bank is next to the school.
The café is opposite the park.
The shop is between the bank and the library.
The car park is behind the cinema.
My house is on Palm Street.
Look at the map. Where is the hospital?

dialogue.t: Look at the map. Where is the bank?
The bank is next to the school.
And where is the cinema?
It's opposite the park. It's on Palm Street.
Where is the café?
It's between the bank and the bookshop.
Great! And where is the car park?
It's behind the cinema.

grammar.title: Prepositions of place
grammar.ar: حروف الجر المكانية تخبرنا أين يوجد الشيء، وتأتي بعد is وقبل the، مثل: next to (بجانب)، opposite (مقابل)، behind (خلف). كلمة between تحتاج إلى مكانين بينهما and. ومع أسماء الشوارع نستخدم on، مثل: It's on King Street.
examples: The library is next to the mosque.
The toy shop is between the café and the bank.
Where is the school? It's on Park Street.

words.ex: Go straight on and you can see the park.
Turn left at the bank.
Turn right at the traffic lights.
The park is on your left.
Stop at the traffic lights.
The shop is on the corner.

dialogue.t: Excuse me, how do I get to the park?
Go out of the mall and turn left.
Turn left. OK.
Then go straight on and turn right at the traffic lights.
Right at the traffic lights?
Yes. The park is on your left. It's next to the mosque.
Thank you very much!
You're welcome!

grammar.title: Giving directions
grammar.ar: لإعطاء الاتجاهات نستخدم صيغة الأمر، فنبدأ الجملة بالفعل مباشرة بدون فاعل، مثل: Go و Turn. نستخدم at قبل المكان الذي ننعطف عنده، مثل: Turn left at the bank. ولكي نسأل عن الطريق بأدب نبدأ بـ Excuse me.
examples: Go straight on.
Turn right at the supermarket.
Excuse me, how do I get to the library?

words.ex: Can I have a notebook, please?
How much is the glue stick?
How much are the scissors?
Have you got any coloured pencils?
The ruler is two riyals.
How much is this notebook?

dialogue.t: Hello. Can I help you?
Hello. Can I have a glue stick, please?
Here you are.
How much is it?
It's three riyals.
Have you got any coloured paper?
Yes, we have. It's five riyals.
Great! Here you are. Thank you!

grammar.title: How much is / How much are
grammar.ar: نستخدم How much is ...? للسؤال عن سعر شيء واحد، ونستخدم How much are ...? للسؤال عن سعر أشياء جمع أو كلمات تأتي دائمًا بصيغة الجمع مثل scissors. لطلب شيء بأدب نقول: Can I have ..., please? ونستخدم any في السؤال: Have you got any ...?
examples: How much is the ruler? It's two riyals.
How much are the coloured pencils?
Can I have a notebook, please?

words.ex: I go to the mall by car.
My brother goes to school by bus.
We go to the city centre by metro.
I walk to the park with my sister.
The airport is far from my house.
The metro is quick.

dialogue.t: How do you get to school?
I go to school by bus.
Why?
Because my school is far. How do you get to school?
I walk to school. It's near my house.
How do you get to the mall?
We go to the mall by metro. It's quick!
Cool! I love the metro.

grammar.title: by + transport / walk to
grammar.ar: نستخدم by مع وسيلة المواصلات بدون a أو the، مثل: by car و by bus. أما عند المشي فنقول: I walk to ... ولا نقول by walk. وللسؤال عن طريقة الوصول نقول: How do you get to ...?
examples: I go to school by car.
I walk to the mosque.
How do you get to the park?

words.ex: In my street there is a skate park.
There is a big fountain in the square.
My perfect street has got a bike lane.
I want an ice cream shop because I love ice cream.
There are lots of trees in my street.
Let's vote for the best street!

dialogue.t: Look at my perfect street!
Wow! What's in your street?
In my street there is a big skate park, and there are lots of trees.
What can you do there?
You can ride your bike. It's got a bike lane.
I want an ice cream shop because I love ice cream!
Good idea! Let's vote.
I vote for the skate park!

grammar.title: You can ... / It's got ... / because
grammar.ar: نستخدم You can + الفعل للتعبير عمّا يمكن فعله في مكان ما، ويبقى الفعل بعد can في صيغته الأصلية بدون إضافات. عبارة It's got تعني «فيه / لديه» وهي اختصار It has got. ونستخدم because لنذكر السبب، ومعناها «لأنّ».
examples: You can play football there.
My street has got a fountain. It's got lots of trees too.
I want a skate park because it's fun.

words.ex: Where were you last weekend?
I was at home on Friday.
We were at the park on Saturday.
My sister was at the mall with my mum.
The park was fun!
It was boring at home.

dialogue.t: Where were you on Friday?
I was at my grandma's house.
How was it?
It was great! Where were you on Saturday?
I was at home. It was boring.
Oh no! We were at the park on Saturday. It was fun.
Can I come with you next time?
Yes, of course!

grammar.title: Was and Were
grammar.ar: نستخدم was وwere للحديث عن الماضي، وهما الماضي من am وis وare. نستخدم was مع I وhe وshe وit، ونستخدم were مع you وwe وthey. للسؤال نضع was أو were قبل الفاعل، مثل: Where were you?
examples: I was at the mall on Friday.
We were at the beach on Saturday.
Where were you last weekend?

words.ex: On Saturday I played football with my brother.
We visited my aunt on Friday.
I watched a film in the evening.
First, I had breakfast.
Then, I played in the garden.
After that, we visited our cousins.

dialogue.t: What did you do on Saturday?
First, I played football with my brother. Then, I watched a film.
Did you visit your cousins?
Yes, I did. We visited them after that. Did you play football?
No, I didn't. I helped my mum at home.
Did you watch TV?
Yes, I did. I watched cartoons in the evening.

grammar.title: Past Simple: -ed Verbs and Did
grammar.ar: للحديث عن شيء حدث في الماضي نضيف ed إلى آخر كثير من الأفعال، مثل play تصبح played. عند السؤال نستخدم Did في البداية ويعود الفعل إلى أصله بدون ed. نجيب بـ Yes, I did أو No, I didn't.
examples: On Friday I visited my grandparents.
Did you watch the football match?
No, I didn't. I played with my sister.

words.ex: We were very happy at Eid.
We visited my grandparents at Eid.
I got a present from my uncle.
I wore a new dress.
My brother wore new clothes on the first day of Eid.
My grandma made sweets for us.

dialogue.t: What did you do at Eid?
We visited my grandparents. My grandma made sweets.
Did you get a present?
Yes! I got a present from my uncle. It was a new ball. What did you do?
We visited my cousins. I got money from my grandpa.
What did you wear?
I wore a new dress. What did you wear?
I wore new white clothes. It was a great Eid!

grammar.title: Irregular Past Verbs
grammar.ar: بعض الأفعال لا نضيف لها ed في الماضي، بل تتغيّر كلمتها كلّها. مثلاً: get تصبح got، وwear تصبح wore، وmake تصبح made، وgo تصبح went. يجب أن نحفظ هذه الأفعال.
examples: I got a present from my aunt.
My sister wore a pink dress.
My mum made a big cake for Eid.

words.ex: We went to the desert last winter.
The beach was beautiful.
We went to the beach by car.
My family went to Dubai by plane.
We saw camels in the desert.
The trip was very exciting!

dialogue.t: Where did you go last holiday?
We went to the desert by car.
Wow! Who went with you?
My mum, my dad and my sister went with me.
What did you see?
We saw camels and a lot of stars. It was beautiful!
Was it hot?
Yes, it was hot in the day, but it was cold at night.

grammar.title: Went to ... by ...
grammar.ar: الفعل went هو الماضي من go ومعناه ذهبَ. نستخدم to قبل المكان، ونستخدم by قبل وسيلة النقل بدون the، مثل by car وby bus وby plane. والفعل saw هو الماضي من see ومعناه رأى.
examples: We went to the beach by bus.
My uncle went to Cairo by plane.
We saw a lot of fish in the sea.

words.ex: Let's have a party on Thursday!
Shall we invite our cousins?
I can bring some biscuits.
We have ten guests at the party.
What games do you want to play?
We need some orange juice.

dialogue.t: Let's have a class party on Thursday!
Good idea! We need some juice and cake.
I can bring the cake. What do you want to bring?
I can bring juice and cups. Shall we invite Miss Sara?
Yes! Let's invite our teacher. What games do you want to play?
Let's play musical chairs!
Great! I love musical chairs!

grammar.title: Making Suggestions: Let's and Shall we
grammar.ar: نستخدم Let's مع الفعل في أصله لنقترح شيئاً نفعله معاً، مثل Let's play. ونستخدم Shall we...? لنسأل صديقنا عن اقتراح. ونقول I can bring عندما نريد أن نتطوّع لإحضار شيء، ونستخدم We need some لنقول ما نحتاجه.
examples: Let's make a big cake!
Shall we invite our grandparents?
We need some balloons. I can bring them.

words.ex: My best day was at the zoo.
I liked it because the animals were funny.
My best day was my birthday.
We went to the zoo with my dad.
The lions were my favourite animals.
What was your best day this year?

dialogue.t: What was your best day this year?
My best day was my birthday.
Who were you with?
I was with my family and my friends. We ate cake and then we played games.
What did you like?
I liked the games because they were funny.
Why was it the best day?
It was the best day because everyone was happy!

grammar.title: Giving Reasons with Because
grammar.ar: نستخدم because لنذكر السبب، ونضعها في وسط الجملة. نجيب بها عن السؤال Why? الذي معناه لماذا. وكلمة the best تعني الأفضل، ونستخدمها لشيء واحد هو الأحسن من كلّ الأشياء.
examples: I liked the trip because we saw dolphins.
It was the best day because my cousins came.
My best day was at the beach with my family.

words.ex: There are many children in the park.
The girl is sitting on the swing.
Two boys are going down the slide.
The boy is flying a kite.
The old man is feeding the birds.

words.ar: نزهة مع طعام في الهواء الطلق
words.ex: The family is having a picnic under a tree.

dialogue.t: Look at my picture. The boy is flying a kite.
In my picture, he is riding a bike, not flying a kite!
OK! What is the man doing in your picture?
He is feeding the birds.
In my picture, he is reading a book, not feeding the birds.
Another difference! Two girls are playing on the swings.
Yes, two girls are playing on the swings in my picture too.
Great! Let's find more differences.

grammar.title: Present Continuous: am / is / are + -ing
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع المستمر للحديث عن شيء يحدث الآن أمامنا. نكوّنه من am أو is أو are ثم الفعل مضافاً إليه ing. مع المفرد نستخدم is، ومع الجمع نستخدم are. انتبه: في العربية نقول «الولد يجري» بدون فعل «يكون»، لكن في الإنجليزية يجب أن نقول The boy is running وليس The boy running.
examples: The boy is flying a kite.
Two girls are playing on the swings.
What is the man doing?

words.ex: What are you doing right now?

words.ar: ابن أو ابنة العم أو الخال
words.ex: My cousin lives in Jeddah.
My mum is in the kitchen.
My dad is cooking rice.
The baby is sleeping now.
My brothers are watching TV.

dialogue.t: Hi, Faisal! What are you doing right now?
Hi, Omar! I'm doing my homework. And you?
I'm talking to you, of course! My dad is cooking in the kitchen.
Cool! My mum is reading a book in the living room.
Where are your sisters? Are they watching TV?
No, they aren't. They're sleeping!
My grandma is sleeping too.
Shh! Let's talk quietly, then.

grammar.title: Present Continuous Questions
grammar.ar: لنسأل سؤالاً جوابه نعم أو لا، نضع am أو is أو are في بداية الجملة قبل الشخص: Are they playing? ونجيب بـ Yes, they are أو No, they aren't. وإذا استخدمنا كلمة سؤال مثل What أو Where نضعها في أول الجملة: What are you doing?
examples: What are you doing right now?
Are they watching TV? No, they aren't.
Is your dad cooking? Yes, he is.

words.ex: What's the weather like in Riyadh?
It's very hot in Riyadh today.
It's sunny, so I'm wearing a cap.
It's windy in Jeddah today.
It's rainy in Abha.
It's cloudy in Tabuk this morning.

dialogue.t: Good morning! What's the weather like in Riyadh?
It's hot and sunny in Riyadh. People are swimming because it's hot.
What's the weather like in Abha?
It's rainy in Abha. People are carrying umbrellas because it's rainy.
And what's the weather like in Jeddah?
It's windy in Jeddah. Children are flying kites because it's windy.
Thank you! And in Tabuk?
It's cold and cloudy in Tabuk. People are wearing jackets because it's cold.

grammar.title: It's + weather / because
grammar.ar: نسأل عن الطقس بـ What's the weather like in...? ونجيب بـ It's ثم صفة الطقس مثل hot أو rainy. لا تنسَ كلمة It، فنقول It's hot وليس Is hot. ونستخدم because بمعنى «لأنّ» لنذكر سبب ما يفعله الناس.
examples: What's the weather like in Dammam?
It's sunny in Riyadh.
People are swimming because it's hot.

words.ex: It's cold, so I need a jacket.
She's wearing a pink scarf.
I'm wearing a green T-shirt today.
He's wearing black boots.
My sister is wearing a new dress for the party.
It's sunny, so I'm wearing a cap.

dialogue.t: Look at the party picture. She's wearing a blue dress and white shoes.
Is she wearing a scarf?
Yes, she is. She's wearing a pink scarf.
Is it Lina? Yes! My turn. He's wearing a black jacket and a red cap.
Is he wearing boots?
Yes, he is. It's cold, so he needs a jacket and boots.
Is it your brother, Ali?
Yes, it is! And I'm wearing a T-shirt today because it's hot.

grammar.title: Wearing / so
grammar.ar: نستخدم is wearing أو am wearing للحديث عن الملابس التي يلبسها شخص الآن. نضع a قبل الاسم المفرد مثل a jacket، ولا نضعها قبل الجمع مثل boots. ونستخدم so بمعنى «لذلك» لنذكر النتيجة: الجو بارد، لذلك أحتاج جاكيت.
examples: She's wearing a dress and a scarf.
It's cold, so I need a jacket.
Is he wearing boots? Yes, he is.

words.ex: The race is starting now!
Our team is winning!
The red team is very good.
Ahmed is passing the ball to Saad.
The boys are jumping very high.
Khalid is running very fast!

dialogue.t: Welcome to Sports Day! Look, the race is starting!
Khalid is running very fast!
Who is winning now?
Yousef is winning! No, wait! Khalid is winning!
Now it's football. Ahmed is passing the ball to Saad.
Saad is kicking the ball... Goal!
The red team is winning! They're jumping and shouting!
What a great Sports Day!

grammar.title: Live commentary: is / are + -ing
grammar.ar: المعلّق الرياضي يستخدم المضارع المستمر لأن الأحداث تحدث أمامه الآن. نضع very قبل الكلمة لتقوية المعنى، مثل very fast أي «سريع جداً». ونسأل عن الشخص الذي يقوم بالفعل بـ Who is ...ing? ونستخدم is دائماً بعد Who.
examples: He's running very fast!
Who is winning now?
She's passing the ball to her friend.

words.ex: I usually walk to school.
We always visit Grandma on Fridays.
Today I'm staying at home.
My dad drinks coffee every day.
He usually plays football, but today he's swimming.
I always play football on Fridays.

dialogue.t: Hi, Salem! Why are you staying at home today?
Because I'm sick. I usually go to the park, but today I'm resting.
Oh no! I always play football on Fridays, but now I'm visiting you!
Thank you! My mum usually works in the morning, but today she's helping me.
What is your brother doing?
He usually plays video games, but today he's reading a story to me.
That's nice! Get well soon.
Thanks, Omar!

grammar.title: Every day vs. Right now
grammar.ar: نستخدم المضارع البسيط مثل play وplays للعادات التي تتكرر، ومعه كلمات مثل usually وalways وevery day. ونستخدم المضارع المستمر am/is/are + ing لما يحدث الآن أو اليوم فقط. مع he وshe نضيف s للفعل في المضارع البسيط: He usually plays. ونربط بين الجملتين بكلمة but.
examples: He usually walks to school, but today he's going by car.
I always play football on Fridays, but now I'm doing my homework.
Why are you wearing a jacket today?

units.cando: Can describe their daily routine and ask others about theirs using simple present tense sentences with times and frequency words.
lessons: Morning Moves
Tell a partner what you do from waking up to arriving at school, then compare routines.
Patterns: I get up at ... o'clock. / Then I ... / What time do you ...? / I ... before/after breakfast.
School Day Schedule
Explain your school timetable to a new online friend and ask about their favourite lesson.
Patterns: On Sunday I have ... / My favourite subject is ... because it's ... / Do you have ... on ...? / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
How Often?
Do a quick interview about healthy habits and report the answers back.
Patterns: I always/usually/sometimes/never ... / How often do you ...? / He/She ... every day.
After-School Time
Plan a balanced afternoon with a partner: homework, sport, family time and screen time.
Patterns: After school I ... / First I ..., then I ... / I like/don't like ...ing. / Can you ... after school?
Family Helpers
Talk about which jobs each family member does at home and offer to help.
Patterns: My brother/sister ... / Who ... in your house? / I help my mum/dad with ... / Can I help you with ...?
A Day in the Life
Present a short 'day in my life' talk and answer two follow-up questions from the teacher.
Patterns: In the morning/afternoon/evening I ... / At the weekend I ... / I think my day is ... because ...

units.cando: Can describe places in their town, say where things are and ask for and give simple directions.
lessons: What's in My Town?
Describe your neighbourhood to a visitor and find out what their town has.
Patterns: There is a ... near my house. / There are some/lots of ... / Is there a ... in your town? / There isn't a ...
Where Is It?
Use a map to find buildings and explain their location to a partner.
Patterns: The ... is next to/opposite/between/behind the ... / Where is the ...? / It's on ... Street.
Finding the Way
Help a lost tourist get from the mall to the park using simple directions.
Patterns: Go straight on. / Turn left/right at the ... / It's on your left/right. / Excuse me, how do I get to the ...?
At the Shop
Role-play buying things for a school project at a stationery shop.
Patterns: Can I have ..., please? / How much is/are ...? / It's ... riyals. / Have you got any ...?
Getting Around
Talk about how you and your family travel to different places and why.
Patterns: I go to ... by car/bus/metro. / I walk to ... / How do you get to ...? / It's quick/far/near.
My Perfect Street
Design and present an ideal street for kids, then vote on the best ideas together.
Patterns: In my street there is/are ... / You can ... there. / I want a ... because ... / It's got a ...

units.cando: Can describe what people are doing at the moment and talk about the weather and clothes using simple present continuous sentences.
lessons: Picture Story
Describe a busy park picture and find differences with a partner's picture.
Patterns: The boy is ...ing. / Two girls are ...ing. / What is the man doing? / In my picture, he is ...ing, not ...ing.
Video Call Check-In
Call a cousin in another city and tell each other what everyone at home is doing now.
Patterns: My dad is ...ing in the kitchen. / What are you doing right now? / I'm ...ing. / Are they ...ing?
Weather Report
Give a short weather report for Saudi cities and say what people are doing because of the weather.
Patterns: It's hot/sunny/windy/rainy in ... / People are ...ing because it's ... / What's the weather like in ...?
What Are You Wearing?
Describe outfits for different weather and events, and guess who a partner is describing.
Patterns: She's wearing a ... and ... / I'm wearing ... today. / It's cold, so I need a ... / Is he wearing ...?
Sports Day Live
Act as a sports commentator describing a school sports day as it happens.
Patterns: He's running very fast! / They're winning! / Who is ...ing now? / She's ...ing the ball to ...
Now vs. Every Day
Compare what someone usually does with what they are doing today, and explain the difference.
Patterns: He usually ..., but today he's ...ing. / I always ... on Fridays, but now I'm ...ing. / Why are you ...ing today?

units.cando: Can talk about past weekends and special occasions such as Eid using was/were and common past simple verbs, and ask simple questions about the past.
lessons: Where Were You?
Ask a partner where they were at different times last weekend and how it was.
Patterns: I was at ... on Friday. / Where were you on ...? / It was fun/boring/great. / We were at ...
My Weekend
Tell the story of your last weekend in three or four sentences using time words.
Patterns: On Saturday I played/visited/watched ... / First ..., then ..., after that ... / Did you ...? / Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
Eid Memories
Share how your family celebrated the last Eid and compare celebrations with a partner.
Patterns: We visited my grandparents. / I got a present from ... / I wore ... / What did you do at Eid?
Family Trip
Describe a trip to the desert, the beach or another city, and answer questions about it.
Patterns: We went to ... by ... / It was hot/beautiful/exciting. / We saw ... / Who went with you?
Party Planning
Plan a family gathering or class celebration together: food, games and guests.
Patterns: Let's ... / We need some ... / Shall we invite ...? / I can bring ... / What do you want to ...?
Best Day Ever
Give a short talk about your best day this year and answer the teacher's follow-up questions.
Patterns: My best day was ... / I was with ... / We ... and then we ... / I liked it because ... / It was the best day because ...
